ownership.title: 1. Owner details
ownership.content: AMG Digitalitzacions is a trademark of Antonio Más Gutiérrez, with tax ID 12345678A and registered address in Mallorca, Balearic Islands. For any enquiries, contact us at info@amgdl.com.

purpose.title: 2. Website purpose
purpose.content: This website aims to provide information about digital automation, web development and artificial intelligence services offered by AMG Digitalitzacions to small and medium businesses in Mallorca.

terms.title: 3. Terms of use
terms.content: The user agrees to use the content and services appropriately and not to engage in any unlawful activities or activities contrary to good faith.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.content: The data controller for personal data collected on this website is Antonio Más Gutiérrez (AMG Digitalitzacions).

dataCollected.title: 2. Data collected
dataCollected.content: We collect: name and surname, email address, phone number, and billing information when services are contracted.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
purpose.content: Data is processed for: managing quote requests, providing contracted services, sending commercial communications (with prior consent), and complying with legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.content: The legal basis for data processing is: execution of a service contract, consent of the data subject, and compliance with legal obligations.

rights.title: 5. Data subject rights
rights.content: Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, deletion, restriction, portability and objection by emailing info@amgdl.com.

security.title: 6. Security measures
security.content: We apply appropriate technical and organisational security measures to protect personal data, including AES-256 encryption for sensitive data and role-based access control.

subprocessors.title: 7. Sub-processors
subprocessors.content: To provide services, AMG Digitalitzacions uses the following sub-processors: Brevo SAS (transactional email, EU-based); Twilio Inc. (WhatsApp and SMS messaging, US-based); Anthropic PBC (text processing for AI agents, US-based); GoCardless Ltd (SEPA direct debit, UK-based); Hetzner Online GmbH (servers and hosting, Germany-based). Each provider has signed appropriate contractual guarantees.

internationalTransfers.title: 8. International transfers
internationalTransfers.content: Some providers (Twilio, Anthropic) are based in the United States. These transfers are carried out with the appropriate safeguards under Art. 46 GDPR, specifically Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission. Data processed by AI agents (Anthropic) is limited to the conversation content necessary to generate responses and is not used to train models.

retention.title: 9. Retention periods
retention.content: Contact data (CRM leads) is retained while an active commercial relationship exists and up to 3 years from the last contact. Billing data is retained for 7 years as required by tax law. Agent conversation logs are retained for 12 months. Upon exercising the right to erasure, personal identifying data is anonymised within a maximum of 30 days.

automatedProcessing.title: 10. Automated processing and AI agents
automatedProcessing.content: The platform includes AI agents that can automatically respond to WhatsApp, Telegram or email messages on behalf of the tenant. These automated responses only occur when the end customer has initiated the conversation. No automated decisions with significant legal effects are made. You may request that your queries be handled by a human by emailing info@amgdl.com.

landing.edit_step_1: Go to the portal and navigate to Landings
landing.edit_step_2: Select the landing you want to edit
landing.edit_step_3: Use the visual editor to modify content
landing.edit_step_4: Click Save to keep your changes
landing.domains_text: You can use a custom domain for your landing. If you manage the domain yourself, you'll need to point the nameservers to our servers.
landing.faq_colors_q: How do I change the color of my landing?
landing.faq_colors_a: In the visual editor, go to the customization tab. You'll find options to change colors, fonts, and styles.
landing.faq_sections_q: How do I add a new section?
landing.faq_sections_a: From the editor, click "Add section" and choose from the available templates.
landing.faq_domain_q: How do I connect my domain?
landing.faq_domain_a: In the landing settings panel, go to the domain section and follow the instructions to configure the nameservers.
landing.faq_seo_q: How do I improve my landing's SEO?
landing.faq_seo_a: The editor includes basic SEO options: title, description, and keywords. For advanced improvements, contact your technician.

whatsapp.access_text: The WhatsApp Business API service is integrated into your portal. You can manage conversations from the inbox.
whatsapp.how_it_works: When a customer sends a message from the web form, it is automatically received in your WhatsApp Business. You can reply directly from the portal.
whatsapp.faq_no_messages_q: Why am I not receiving messages?
whatsapp.faq_no_messages_a: Check that the phone number is verified in Meta and that the webhook is correctly configured.
whatsapp.faq_change_number_q: How do I change the WhatsApp number?
whatsapp.faq_change_number_a: You need to configure a new number from the Meta Business panel and update the credentials in your portal.
whatsapp.faq_template_q: How do I create message templates?
whatsapp.faq_template_a: WhatsApp Business templates are managed from the Meta Business panel. They will need Meta approval before use.

smtp.outlook_step_1: Open Outlook and go to Settings
smtp.outlook_step_2: Add an email account and select Manual setup
smtp.outlook_step_3: Enter the SMTP credentials (server, port, username, password) with TLS
smtp.gmail_step_3: Add an email account from Accounts and Import
smtp.gmail_step_4: Select "Add a mail account" and enter the SMTP details
smtp.thunderbird_step_1: Open Thunderbird and go to File > New > Mail
smtp.faq_send_a: Verify that your email client uses the correct port (587 with TLS or 465 with SSL). Check that the password is correct.
smtp.faq_port_a: Port 587 with TLS (recommended) or port 465 with SSL. Port 25 is not available for security reasons.
smtp.faq_auth_q: Why does it keep asking me for authentication?
smtp.faq_auth_a: Make sure you have checked "Remember password" in your email client. If the issue persists, generate an app password.

bot_ia.how_it_works: The AI bot automatically responds to your customers' messages 24/7. You can customize responses and tone from the management panel.
bot_ia.faq_add_info_q: How do I add more information to the bot?
bot_ia.faq_add_info_a: From the knowledge management panel, you can upload PDF, TXT, or DOCX documents for the bot to learn from.
bot_ia.faq_bad_response_q: Why isn't the bot responding correctly?
bot_ia.faq_bad_response_a: Check that the knowledge base has sufficient and up-to-date information. If the problem persists, adjust the bot's tone and instructions.
bot_ia.faq_integration_q: Can it be integrated with WhatsApp?
bot_ia.faq_integration_a: Yes, the bot can be integrated with WhatsApp Business, Telegram, and the web chat. Manage integrations from the agents panel.

automation.workflows_text: Workflows automate repetitive tasks in your business. Each workflow has a specific function: sending emails, managing leads, updating data, etc.
automation.manage_step_1: Access n8n from the access link
automation.manage_step_3: From the panel, you can activate, deactivate, or modify workflows
automation.faq_failed_q: The workflow failed, what do I do?
automation.faq_failed_a: Check the error log in n8n. It is usually a connection issue with an external API. If you can't resolve it, contact your technician.
automation.faq_new_automations_a: Yes, you can create new workflows from the n8n panel. If you need help, ask your assigned technician.
automation.faq_monitoring_q: How do I know if workflows are running?
automation.faq_monitoring_a: n8n shows the status of each workflow (active, inactive, error). You can also configure alert notifications via email or Telegram.

domain.setup_step_2: Change the nameservers to the ones in the DNS section
domain.propagation_text: DNS propagation can take between 24 and 72 hours to complete worldwide. During this time, your domain may be accessible from some locations but not others.
domain.faq_time_q: How long does domain propagation take?
domain.faq_time_a: Usually between 24 and 48 hours, but it can take up to 72 hours in extreme cases.
domain.faq_not_visible_q: My website is not showing after 72h
domain.faq_not_visible_a: Check that the nameservers are correctly configured at your registrar. If they are, contact your technician.
domain.faq_ssl_q: How is the SSL certificate generated?
domain.faq_ssl_a: The SSL certificate is automatically generated once the domain points to our servers. It can take up to 15 minutes.
